question: After the pacing bug is fixed, should this PR keep ambiguous outbound entries pending when no reconciliation-capable adapter exists instead of moving them to failed?
rationale: That behavior affects existing queue recovery semantics and message-delivery observability, so code review can identify the risk but cannot choose the product tradeoff for maintainers.

options.title: Fix pacing and accept pending deferrals
options.body: Repair the no-op pacing issue, then merge the recoverable pending behavior as the preferred no-blind-replay mitigation.

options.title: Keep fail-closed recovery
options.body: Reject this branch's behavior and leave no-reconciler ambiguous entries moving to failed until a fuller delivery ledger/reconciliation design lands.

recommendation.title: Fix pacing and accept pending deferrals
recommendation.body: Repair the no-op pacing issue, then merge the recoverable pending behavior as the preferred no-blind-replay mitigation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent recovery PRs were merged under this reviewer, making this the best available owner for the final message-delivery tradeoff.
